Our work

Seven ways we help, in two places.

Our roots are in Maricopa, Arizona. Our branches reach into Benin, West Africa. Each service below says who it is for and what to do next.

Our roots

Arizona

Practical help for neighbors in and around Maricopa, toward a safer, steadier next step.

Call (402) 870-8800

Food and clothing

We support people experiencing homelessness with everyday essentials.

Next stepCall us to talk about what you need and what support is available right now.

Help finding shelter

We help people connect with shelter options. We do not promise a bed or run an emergency housing line.

Next stepTell us where you are, and we will talk through the next step.

Support after incarceration

Coming home can mean starting over with very little. We walk alongside people as they reconnect with their community and look for practical help.

Next stepCall us, or ask a family member or caseworker to call with you.

A way into recovery

We help people struggling with drug or alcohol use find a treatment or recovery program, and stay with them as they take that step. We are not a clinical treatment provider.

Next stepCall us. Partners in treatment and recovery are welcome to call too.

Our branches

Benin

Care in partnership with local churches and communities, starting in Cotonou.

Discuss a partnership

Hospital visits and medical bills

We visit patients, pray with them, and help families with medical bills when resources allow. Our Easter 2026 outreach took place at CNHU-HKM in Cotonou.

Next stepHospitals and churches in Benin can contact us to discuss working together.

Staying in school

We help children who struggle to access education stay in school.

Next stepContact the team to discuss education needs or a partnership.

Food and clothing for families

We support families with food and clothing, working alongside people and organizations in the community.

Next stepChurches and community groups can contact us to coordinate.
